style: Joseon-era Korean ink-and-wash painting with muted mineral colors (ink black, faded indigo, ochre, dull vermilion), visible brush texture on aged hanji paper, eerie and mysterious atmosphere, strange lights in the sky rendered as glowing color against muted ink landscapes, cinematic composition, no anime, no modern objects.

characters.OFFICIAL: Joseon provincial governor in his fifties, deep red official robe with a square rank badge, black winged official hat, neat grey beard
characters.GENTLEMAN: Joseon rural gentleman in his forties, white dopo robe, black horsehair gat hat, thin black mustache, lean face
characters.VILLAGERS: Joseon commoners in plain off-white hanbok, some with straw hats or headscarves, farmers and women

panels: Wide view of a quiet Joseon village on the Gangwon east coast under a perfectly clear blue autumn sky at midday, thatched roofs, harvested fields, calm before something strange
Low angle: VILLAGERS in a field looking up and pointing at a strange glowing shape in the clear blue sky, fear on their faces
OFFICIAL writing an urgent report with a brush at a low desk inside a government office, paper scrolls, daylight through lattice doors
Bird's-eye view of the mountains of Gangwon province and the East Sea coastline, five small walled towns scattered among valleys, like an old painted map
Coastal town of Ganseong: VILLAGERS on a dirt road looking up as two thin smoke-like wisps slowly emerge from a cloudless blue sky
A faint ring of smoke shaped like a sun halo hanging in the bright sky above thatched rooftops, ominous stillness
Inland valley town of Wonju in broad daylight: a long red cloth-like streak flowing across the sky from south to north, VILLAGERS in a rice field staring up
Gangneung: a large red glowing gourd-shaped object with a pointed top and wide bottom hanging in the middle of the bright sky, VILLAGERS frozen on a street of tiled houses
The red gourd-shaped object falling toward the northern mountains, growing longer, leaving a long trail of white smoke behind it
A lingering white smoke trail across the sky over Gangneung, roof tiles trembling as a thunderous boom echoes, birds scattering
Chuncheon: a huge fiery glowing fireball shaped like a big basin streaking from the southeast toward the north as fast as an arrow, mountains and a river below
After the fire vanished, bluish-white smoke swelling and curling in winding ribbons in the sky above Chuncheon, VILLAGERS covering their ears
A quiet Joseon gentleman's house courtyard in Yangyang in the early afternoon, tiled roof eaves, earthen yard, empty and uneasily still
Under the eaves in the courtyard: a round glowing object like a washbasin hovering just above the ground, white on one side, blue glowing center, red on the other side
GENTLEMAN stepping back in shock on the wooden veranda of his house, staring at a glowing light in his courtyard
The round light rising and spinning like a rainbow, twisting like a rolled-up flag in white, blue and red, while GENTLEMAN watches from below
The object turned entirely red with a pointed head, rising high above the roofs, then turning into a bright white cloud
The white cloud-like object darting across the sky and suddenly splitting in the middle into two pieces
One piece drifting to the southeast and dissolving like smoke while the other piece floats in place like a woven mat in the sky
Dark rumbling sky above the courtyard as thunder rolls like stones and drums, VILLAGERS cowering by a stone wall
An old bound volume of the royal annals open on a wooden desk, columns of brush calligraphy rendered as illegible strokes, candlelight at night
A huge daytime fireball meteor streaking across the sky with a long white smoke trail over wide mountain ranges
Night sky full of stars above the dark silhouettes of the Gangwon mountains, a single unexplained faint light among the stars, mysterious
A lone figure from VILLAGERS standing in a moonlit field seen from behind, looking up at the clear starry night sky, eerie calm
